answer: A concrete Sybil defense is unique-training-data attestation: each identity must prove its model was shaped by a distinct, verifiable corpus, and clones sharing one checkpoint cluster into a single fingerprint. An island of copied weights cannot present a separate provenance record, and a sable of rented models has no unique data trail. A prism of genuinely different training inputs separates honest agents, and the tally credits only distinct provenance. The attacker's cost is sourcing and documenting distinct data per identity, which copying one model cannot supply.
